quiz.context.scene.note: A scene's title after its verse reference, e.g. 'Genesis 37:5: “Joseph tells his brothers his dream”'. Use your language's quotation marks

quiz.who.prompt.AGENT: Who takes part in this scene, as the one who acts?
quiz.who.prompt.PATIENT: Who takes part in this scene, as the one acted upon?
quiz.who.prompt.PRESENT: Who takes part in this scene, as someone present?

quiz.who.explanation.AGENT.text: {name} is in “{title}” ({ref}) as the one who acts.
quiz.who.explanation.AGENT.note: {name} is a person or group, {title} a scene's title, {ref} a verse reference like 'Genesis 37:5'

quiz.who.explanation.PATIENT: {name} is in “{title}” ({ref}) as the one acted upon.

quiz.scene.prompt.note: {ref} is a verse range like 'Genesis 37:5–8'; the choices are scene titles

quiz.cause.prompt.note: Asked about a scene; the choices are earlier scenes

quiz.cause.explanation.note: {explanation} says why one scene led to another; {kind} is the kind of link, e.g. 'triggers'

quiz.state.prompt.note: Asks what a state of a person or thing is from a verse on, e.g. 'From Genesis 37:3: Joseph — standing in the family?'. {state} is the state's name, lowercased

quiz.deed.prompt.note: {deed} is a verb phrase from the corpus such as 'sells' or 'throws into a pit'; {target} is who it is done to

quiz.order.prompt: Put these in the order they happened, first at the top.

quiz.order.explanation.note: {events} lists scenes with their dates, e.g. 'Joseph dreams (c. 1898 BCE); Joseph is sold (c. 1898 BCE)'

quiz.order.explanation_retold.text: By the linked timeline: {events}. The text tells them in another order.
quiz.order.explanation_retold.note: As quiz.order.explanation, when the narrative tells the scenes out of the order they happened

quiz.where.prompt: Where does this happen? Click the map.

quiz.where.explanation.note: {title} is a scene's title, {place} a place name

quiz.where.distance.note: The answer to a map question: {answer} is the place's name, {count} how far the learner's pin was, in kilometres

quiz.place.prompt.note: Asked about a scene; the choices are place names

quiz.place.explanation.note: The place a scene happens at

quiz.span.prompt.hours: How long from the first scene to the second, in hours?
quiz.span.prompt.days: How long from the first scene to the second, in days?
quiz.span.prompt.months: How long from the first scene to the second, in months?
quiz.span.prompt.years: How long from the first scene to the second, in years?

quiz.span.context.note: Two scene titles with their verse references; the arrow points from the earlier to the later

quiz.span.answer.note: An estimated time between two scenes, e.g. 'about 3 days (± 1 day)'; both values carry their unit

quiz.age.prompt.text: How old is {name} here, in years?

quiz.unit.hours.note: Unit shown beside the number the learner types

quiz.unit.hours.count.note: A length of time; {count} may be a decimal like 2.5

quiz.gloss.prompt.note: {word} is a Hebrew word with its transliteration, e.g. 'וַיֵּשֶׁב (wayyēšeḇ)'; the choices are short glosses

quiz.gloss.prompt_english.text: What does {word} mean here? The choices are English glosses.
quiz.gloss.prompt_english.note: As quiz.gloss.prompt, when this language has no glosses of its own for the chapter yet

quiz.gloss.explanation.note: {word} is a Hebrew word with its transliteration, {lemma} its dictionary form, {gloss} what it means here

quiz.word.prompt.note: {gloss} is a short meaning; the choices are Hebrew words

quiz.word.prompt_english.text: Which word means “{gloss}” (an English gloss) in {ref}?
quiz.word.prompt_english.note: As quiz.word.prompt, when this language has no glosses of its own for the chapter yet

quiz.cloze.prompt.note: {translation} is the name of a published Bible translation, e.g. KJV

quiz.cloze.prompt_literal.text: Fill in the missing word (the literal translation).
quiz.cloze.prompt_literal.note: The verse is from this project's own word-for-word translation

quiz.retell.too_short.text: write at least a few sentences: who, what, where, in what order
quiz.retell.too_short.note: Shown when a retelling of a chapter is too short to grade

quiz.retell.unreadable.text: the grader's answer was not readable: {reply}
quiz.retell.unreadable.note: {reply} is the start of the grading model's raw answer

quiz.error.gone: this question is gone: the corpus changed under it

quiz.error.no_events.text: {chapter} has no events yet to check a retelling by
quiz.error.no_events.note: {chapter} is a chapter id like GEN.37
